newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Manuel says six pct growth attainable.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Manuel says six pct growth attainable.

text.p: South African Finance Minister Trevor Manuel said on Thursday he believed the government's target of six percent real GDP growth by the end of the decade was attainable.
"The six percent target for the year 2000 is attainable. We remain of the view the deviations from GEAR will not be substantial," he told a news briefing.
The government's Growth, Employment and Redistribution (GEAR) strategy, published last June, set a target of doubling growth to 6.1 percent by 2000.
